test_nested_modules: test that pybind11 nested modules have correct __name__ attributes and submodule functions work
test_reference_internal: test pybind11 internal reference handling by creating objects with A and B classes and checking constructor stats
test_importing: test that pybind11 modules can import and expose Python built-in types like OrderedDict
test_pydoc: test that pydoc can generate documentation for pybind11 modules and their attributes
test_duplicate_registration: test that registering two items with the same name in a pybind11 module returns an empty list
